sections.label: HDB industrial properties transfer to JTC
sections.summary: The amendments transfer HDB's industrial properties to JTC, consolidating all public sector industrial properties under one agency.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade) (Mr Lim Hng Kiang)
sentences.text: The first set of amendments provides for the transfer of the Housing and Development Board's (HDB's) industrial properties to Jurong Town Corporation (JTC).

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade) (Mr Lim Hng Kiang)
sentences.text: With the transfer, all public sector industrial properties will be consolidated under one agency.

sections.label: Transfer of HDB contracts and records
sections.summary: Sections 37 and 40 provide for transferring HDB's contracts and records to JTC, with no change to contractual terms for existing HDB customers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade) (Mr Lim Hng Kiang)
sentences.text: Sections 37 and 40 of the Bill thus provide for the transfer of the HDB's contracts and records associated with the transferred properties to JTC, with no change to the contractual terms for existing HDB customers.

sections.label: JTC prescribing offences and fines
sections.summary: Section 27 will allow JTC to prescribe offences and associated fines for non-compliance instead of Court action for minor offences.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade) (Mr Lim Hng Kiang)
sentences.text: Instead of taking protracted and costly Court action for minor offences in these areas, section 27 will allow JTC to prescribe offences and associated fines for non-compliance.

sections.label: Consolidation of public sector industrial properties
sections.summary: With this transfer, all public sector industrial properties will be consolidated under one agency.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: With this transfer, all public sector industrial properties will be consolidated under one agency.

sections.label: SME rental and property costs
sections.summary: Members highlighted in 2016 and 2017 COS debates that rental and property-related costs for SMEs are very high relative to most other countries.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: In the Committee of Supply (COS) debates in 2016 and 2017, this was highlighted by various Members of this House, such as Mr Dennis Tan and Mr Chen Show Mao.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: This has, over the years, led to a situation where the rental and property-related costs faced by our small and medium enterprises (SMEs) are very high, relative to most other countries.

sections.label: LaunchPads and JTC industrial space
sections.summary: JTC set up LaunchPad@one-north in 2015 and plans a network of LaunchPads; the Government accepted that the state should sometimes provide lower-cost land to SMEs and startups.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: JTC set up LaunchPad@one-north in 2015, and plans to build a network of LaunchPads around Singapore".

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: This year, Senior Minister of State Koh Poh Koon said, "However, in terms of the market share, JTC industrial space currently constitute only 8% of all industrial space and we do not have the critical mass to influence overall market pricing".

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: The Government has accepted the principle that, in certain cases, the state should step in to provide land at lower costs to SMEs and startups.

sections.label: Benchmarking SME startup countries
sections.summary: The speaker suggests benchmarking Singapore against Germany, Switzerland, Japan and Israel, countries known for thriving SME and startup sectors.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: So, my questions and suggestions would be as follows.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: It would be useful, in my view, to benchmark against Germany, Switzerland, Japan and Israel, which are countries known for thriving SME and startup sectors.

sections.label: JTC market share land costs
sections.summary: The speaker asks whether MTI would pursue land cost targets by having JTC take a larger market share in industrial and commercial property.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Thirdly, would MTI consider pursuing such land cost targets by JTC taking up a larger market share in the industrial and commercial property market, as was the case in the past?

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: JTC taking a larger share of the market for industrial and office space would send a strong signal to SMEs that manageable space costs will be here to stay and would not simply be gone tomorrow by the next market fluctuation, thus potentially wiping out the viability of a business that could have taken the founders of the business years or even decades of hard work and forgone income to build up.

sections.label: Minimising rentals for entrepreneurship
sections.summary: The speaker says minimising industrial and commercial rentals and property costs is important to stimulate entrepreneurship and the SME sector.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Taking every effort to minimise industrial and commercial rentals and property costs is important to stimulate entrepreneurship and the SME sector to be the vital third engine of value and job creation that we need it to be.

sections.label: Transferring HDB industrial properties to JTC
sections.summary: The amendment transfers HDB-managed industrial units and land leases to JTC in the first quarter of next year, with affected HDB employees transferred too.

sentences.speaker: Mr Thomas Chua Kee Seng (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: The main purpose of this amendment is to transfer all the industrial units and industrial land leases currently managed by HDB, to JTC in the first quarter of next year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Thomas Chua Kee Seng (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: According to clause 5, section 38 of the Bill, after the transfer, all those HDB employees responsible for managing the industrial properties will be transferred to JTC.

sections.label: JTC lease terms unchanged
sections.summary: JTC stated that after the transfer of industrial properties, the lease terms of industrial tenants would remain unchanged.

sentences.speaker: Mr Thomas Chua Kee Seng (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: JTC stated that "after the transfer of industrial properties, the lease terms of industrial tenants would remain unchanged".

sections.label: Affordable space for micro enterprises
sections.summary: The speaker hopes JTC will continue providing smaller industrial units and space at more affordable rentals for micro and small enterprises.

sentences.speaker: Mr Thomas Chua Kee Seng (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: The ultimate value of these traditional industries lies in their being able to exist well to serve the public at large.

sentences.speaker: Mr Thomas Chua Kee Seng (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Hence, I do hope JTC would continue to set aside and provide smaller-size industrial units and space with more affordable rentals for the micro and small enterprises, to enable these family businesses and traditional industries to carry on their businesses from generation to generation.

sections.label: Rental prices and tenancy renewal
sections.summary: The speaker asks the Minister whether tenants with expiring tenancies will face rental price increases in new JTC tenancies.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Of primary concerns are changes in rental prices and tenancy renewal.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: I appreciate that JTC has confirmed that there will be no changes in rental prices under the current tenancies, which will continue under JTC.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Can I ask the Minister if there are any tenants who will have their tenancy expiring soon and whether in negotiating their new tenancies under JTC, there will be an increase in their rental prices?

sections.label: Divestment plans and rental increases
sections.summary: The speaker asks the Minister about the timeframe for no divestment plans and whether that decision will be reviewed annually.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Some of the comments I have received on Facebook said that the tenants' rental prices were increased when Mapletree took over.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: I appreciate that JTC has confirmed that there are no divestment plans currently.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: However, can I ask the Minister if there is a timeframe for this and whether this decision of not having a divestment plan will be reviewed annually or is one that is cast in stone?
